# OnwardCraft

> OnwardCraft is a web design, SEO, and lead-generation agency built exclusively for home-service contractors and the trades — roofing, HVAC, plumbing, solar, electrical, and restoration. We turn contractor websites into revenue machines that rank, convert, and book jobs.

## Overview

OnwardCraft is a founder-led agency that works with one kind of business: home-service contractors. That focus means our websites, local SEO, and lead systems are tuned to how each trade actually wins work — storm cycles, 24/7 emergencies, seasonal demand, and long high-ticket sales.

What we do:

- **Web Design** — Fast, mobile-first, conversion-focused contractor websites built on Astro for sub-2-second load times.
- **SEO** — Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization that wins the map pack for "near me" searches.
- **Lead Generation** — Complete systems to capture, qualify, and convert high-intent homeowners into booked jobs.

We start every engagement with a free, no-obligation website and SEO audit delivered within two business days.

## Industries We Serve

OnwardCraft specializes exclusively in home-service trades:

- [Roofing Marketing](https://onwardcraft.com/industries/roofing/) — Storm-ready websites, insurance-claim content, and storm-response campaigns
- [HVAC Marketing](https://onwardcraft.com/industries/hvac/) — 24/7 emergency capture, maintenance-agreement growth, and seasonal campaigns
- [Plumbing Marketing](https://onwardcraft.com/industries/plumbing/) — Emergency-first sites and map-pack domination for "plumber near me"
- [Solar Marketing](https://onwardcraft.com/industries/solar/) — Education-led content and nurture that lowers customer acquisition cost
- [Electrical Marketing](https://onwardcraft.com/industries/electrical/) — Trust-forward sites for residential, commercial, and EV-charger work
- [Restoration Marketing](https://onwardcraft.com/industries/restoration/) — 24/7 emergency capture and insurance referral relationships
